角色.def_en: A named person in the game.

可操作角色.def_zh: 玩家可以操作用于战斗的角色
可操作角色.def_en: A character that the player can control in combat.

元素属性角色.def_zh: 能造成元素伤害的角色
元素属性角色.def_en: A character that deals elemental damage.

风属性角色.def_zh: 驱使风元素的力量，造成风属性伤害
风属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Anemo and deals Anemo damage.

火属性角色.def_zh: 驱使火元素的力量，造成火属性伤害
火属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Pyro and deals Pyro damage.

雷属性角色.def_zh: 驱使雷元素的力量，造成雷属性伤害
雷属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Electro and deals Electro damage.

岩属性角色.def_zh: 驱使岩元素的力量，造成岩属性伤害
岩属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Geo and deals Geo damage.

水属性角色.def_zh: 驱使水元素的力量，造成水属性伤害
水属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Hydro and deals Hydro damage.

冰属性角色.def_zh: 驱使冰元素的力量，造成冰属性伤害
冰属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Cryo and deals Cryo damage.

草属性角色.def_zh: 驱使草元素的力量，造成草属性伤害
草属性角色.def_en: Wields the power of Dendro and deals Dendro damage.

武器类型角色.def_zh: 按所使用的武器类型划分的可操作角色
武器类型角色.def_en: A playable character classified by the type of weapon it wields.

单手剑角色.def_zh: 使用单手剑作战的角色
单手剑角色.def_en: A character who fights with a sword.

双手剑角色.def_zh: 使用双手剑作战的角色
双手剑角色.def_en: A character who fights with a claymore.

长柄武器角色.def_zh: 使用长柄武器作战的角色
长柄武器角色.def_en: A character who fights with a polearm.

弓箭角色.def_zh: 使用弓箭进行远程射击的角色
弓箭角色.def_en: A character who fights with a bow (archer).

法器角色.def_zh: 使用法器作战的角色，又称法师
法器角色.def_en: A character who fights with a catalyst (wizard).

输出角色.def_zh: 擅长输出、造成伤害的角色
输出角色.def_en: A character who specializes in dealing damage.

站场输出角色.def_en: A character who deals sustained damage while on the field.

速切输出角色.def_en: A character who deals burst damage in quick-swap play.

后台输出角色.def_zh: 擅长使用召唤物、创造物、协同攻击、间歇性攻击、或后台攻击的角色
后台输出角色.def_en: A character who deals damage through summons, creations, coordinated, intermittent or off-field attacks.

辅助角色.def_zh: 擅长强化队友、弱化对手、或保护队友的角色
辅助角色.def_en: A character who buffs teammates, debuffs opponents, or protects teammates.

增伤辅助角色.def_zh: 擅长强化队友或弱化对手的角色
增伤辅助角色.def_en: A character good at buffing teammates or debuffing opponents.

聚怪辅助角色.def_en: A character good at gathering enemies together.

生存辅助角色.def_zh: 提供护盾或治疗的角色
生存辅助角色.def_en: A character who provides shields or healing.

不可操作角色.def_en: A character the player cannot control.

创造物.def_zh: 角色或怪物在战斗中创造的生物、物体或领域
创造物.def_en: A creature, object or field created by a character or monster in combat.

召唤物.def_zh: 角色或怪物在战斗中召唤的生物或物体，通常可以自动提供进攻或治疗
召唤物.def_en: A creature or object summoned by a character or monster in combat, usually attacking or healing automatically.

岩造物.def_en: A creation that can be destroyed.

领域.def_zh: 在一定范围内提供增益、减益、或伤害效果
领域.def_en: Provides buffs, debuffs or damage within a certain area.

武器.def_zh: 可操作角色使用的武器
武器.def_en: A weapon used by playable characters.

单手剑.def_en: A slender sword wielded with one hand.

双手剑.def_en: A great sword wielded with two hands.

长柄武器.def_en: A long spear-like weapon wielded with two hands.

弓箭.def_zh: 可进行远程射击的武器

法器.def_zh: 可进行中程攻击、且攻击附带神之眼属性的武器
法器.def_en: A weapon for mid-range attacks whose attacks carry the element of the wielder's Vision.

圣遗物.def_zh: 可操作角色装备时，大幅提升战斗属性的装备
圣遗物.def_en: Equipment that greatly increases the combat attributes of the playable character who equips it.

输出圣遗物.def_zh: 主要效果是提升装备者自身输出的圣遗物
输出圣遗物.def_en: An artifact whose main effect increases the wearer's own damage output.

辅助圣遗物.def_zh: 主要效果是提升队伍的生存、或队友输出的圣遗物
辅助圣遗物.def_en: An artifact whose main effect increases the team's survivability or the teammates' damage output.

敌人.def_zh: 向玩家发起攻击、或玩家攻击的对象
敌人.def_en: An object that attacks the player or that the player attacks.

普通敌人.def_zh: 大世界中常见的普通怪物
普通敌人.def_en: A common monster found throughout the open world.

精英敌人.def_zh: 比普通敌人更强大、掉落精英材料的怪物
精英敌人.def_en: A stronger monster than common enemies that drops elite materials.

首领.def_zh: 需要专门挑战的强大敌人
首领.def_en: A powerful enemy that must be challenged specifically.

世界首领.def_zh: 在大世界中可重复挑战、掉落角色突破材料的首领
世界首领.def_en: A boss in the open world that can be challenged repeatedly and drops character ascension materials.

周本首领.def_zh: 每周可领取奖励的首领，掉落天赋培养材料
周本首领.def_en: A boss whose rewards can be claimed a limited number of times per week; drops talent materials.

材料.def_zh: 可采集的物品，或战胜怪物后可获得的战利品，可用于强化角色或武器
材料.def_en: A collectible item or a spoil obtained from defeating monsters, used to enhance characters or weapons.

角色养成材料.def_zh: 用于提升角色等级、突破或天赋的材料
角色养成材料.def_en: A material used to level up, ascend or upgrade the talents of characters.

角色经验材料.def_zh: 提升角色经验等级的材料，如大英雄的经验
角色经验材料.def_en: A material that grants character EXP, e.g., Hero's Wit.

角色突破材料.def_zh: 角色突破所需的材料，如元素晶石与首领掉落物
角色突破材料.def_en: A material required for character ascension, such as gemstones and boss drops.

天赋培养材料.def_zh: 提升角色天赋等级的材料，如天赋书与周本掉落物
天赋培养材料.def_en: A material used to level up talents, such as talent books and weekly boss drops.

武器养成材料.def_zh: 用于提升武器等级或突破的材料
武器养成材料.def_en: A material used to enhance or ascend weapons.

武器经验材料.def_zh: 提升武器经验等级的材料，如精锻用魔矿
武器经验材料.def_en: A material that grants weapon EXP, e.g., Mystic Enhancement Ore.

武器突破材料.def_zh: 武器突破所需的材料，通常在秘境中获得
武器突破材料.def_en: A material required for weapon ascension, usually obtained from domains.

区域特产.def_zh: 各地区野外可采集的特产植物或矿物，用于角色突破
区域特产.def_en: A regional plant or mineral collected in the wild, used for character ascension.

烹饪食材.def_en: An ingredient used to cook dishes.

锻造材料.def_zh: 用于锻造武器的矿石等材料
锻造材料.def_en: Ore and other materials used to forge weapons.

技能.def_zh: 可操作角色的天赋与命之座等能力
技能.def_en: The abilities of playable characters, including combat talents, passive talents and constellations.

普通攻击.def_zh: 角色的普通攻击、重击与下落攻击
普通攻击.def_en: A character's normal attacks, charged attacks and plunging attacks.

元素战技.def_zh: 角色的元素战技，通常以E键释放
元素战技.def_en: A character's Elemental Skill, usually cast with the E key.

元素爆发.def_zh: 消耗元素能量释放的强力技能，通常以Q键释放
元素爆发.def_en: A powerful skill that consumes Elemental Energy, usually cast with the Q key.

固有天赋.def_zh: 角色突破后解锁的被动天赋
固有天赋.def_en: A passive talent unlocked through ascension.

命之座.def_zh: 消耗命星解锁的角色强化效果
命之座.def_en: A character enhancement unlocked by consuming Stella Fortuna.

元素反应.def_zh: 不同元素相互作用产生的反应
元素反应.def_en: A reaction produced when different elements interact.

增幅反应.def_zh: 提升触发伤害倍率的元素反应，如蒸发与融化
增幅反应.def_en: A reaction that multiplies the triggering damage, such as Vaporize and Melt.

剧变反应.def_zh: 产生额外伤害或效果的元素反应，如超载、扩散、绽放
剧变反应.def_en: A reaction that creates additional damage or effects, such as Overloaded, Swirl and Bloom.

激化反应.def_zh: 草元素与雷元素相关的激化类反应，如超激化与蔓激化
激化反应.def_en: The Quicken family of Dendro/Electro reactions, such as Aggravate and Spread.

月曜反应.def_zh: 与月相关的特殊元素反应，如月感电、月绽放
月曜反应.def_en: Special moon-related elemental reactions, such as Lunar-Charged and Lunar-Bloom.

地区.def_zh: 提瓦特大陆上的国家与地区
地区.def_en: A nation or region on the continent of Teyvat.

蒙德.def_zh: 风神统治的自由之国及其境内地点
蒙德.def_en: The nation of freedom ruled by the Anemo Archon, and places within it.

璃月.def_zh: 岩神统治的契约之国及其境内地点
璃月.def_en: The nation of contracts ruled by the Geo Archon, and places within it.

稻妻.def_zh: 雷神统治的永恒之国及其境内地点
稻妻.def_en: The nation of eternity ruled by the Electro Archon, and places within it.

须弥.def_zh: 草神统治的智慧之国及其境内地点
须弥.def_en: The nation of wisdom ruled by the Dendro Archon, and places within it.

枫丹.def_zh: 水神统治的正义之国及其境内地点
枫丹.def_en: The nation of justice ruled by the Hydro Archon, and places within it.

纳塔.def_zh: 火神统治的战争之国及其境内地点
纳塔.def_en: The nation of war ruled by the Pyro Archon, and places within it.
